title: Elevator Wool
description: Wool elevators for Folia and Canvas.
body:
Create elevators using wool of any color and enderperls.

- Place wool.
- Drop an enderperl on the wool.
- Repeat anywhere above or below.
- Jump to go up, Sneak to go down.

It's also possible for multiple colors to overlap as shown in the video.

The reason for this is that the datapack which does this cannot be used on Folia or Canvas.
